result.summary: No clear visual breakage is apparent. The page appears generally well-aligned; the partially visible category chip and restaurant cards on the right look like intentional horizontal carousels. One minor viewport overlap is visible near the bottom.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the next restaurant card, obscuring a substantial portion of its image and content at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable feed (at least the height of the bottom navigation plus safe-area spacing) so cards can scroll fully above the navigation.
